brief:
Israel's opposition parties have seized on the Democratic Party's strong performance in US midterm elections as evidence that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has damaged the country's standing abroad, Al Jazeera English reported. Opposition figures argued the results demonstrate Israel "cannot afford" to keep Netanyahu in office, with critics describing his leadership as "toxic" and suggesting his policies have alienated traditional allies.

Netanyahu faces legal challenges and political rivals who have accused him of mishandling international relations. Opposition figures linked the midterm results directly to his governance, framing the Democratic gains as a referendum on his approach to the US relationship.
dek: Netanyahu's rivals say US midterm results show Israel 'cannot afford' to have the prime minister remain in office.
title: Israeli opposition blames Netanyahu for Democrats' US midterm gains
